//: Overrides People First's stub.  pf_eng_level = the engine patch level this mod goes with (16: items answer PF_ROTTEN, PF_GOING_BAD and PF_ZOMBIE_CORPSE; 23: u_pf_eat_share).  On the stock build the stub leaves it at 0, and nothing asks an item those flags (an unknown flag is an error screen there).

Overrides People First's stub (people/people_menu.json).  u = the eater, npc = the food.  Engine patch 23: half the food goes into your stomach, as eating does, so it fills you, counts in the eat menu's Consumed today, and digests.  Patch 23b: reading u_pf_eat_share() gives how much of it still fits (full run day 180: 'Your stomach is full to bursting'), so you eat only what fits; full, you mostly keep them company.

else.u_message: You're too full for more than a bite, so most of it goes to them.
